label: Every actual root withholds each grounded being, from willed giving, WN and SS
description: Argument N3, the will route (the structure of ST I q.19 a.3 co., navigation only, not attributed): a second, partly independent support bundle for (a), from the will and perfection families instead of the modal profile of the root's giving. Not a transcription. Establishes no premise. Simplicity enters through one power: it makes every giving of the root an exercise of its one rational power (uniform kind of power), not a uniform mode; WN and SS supply the mode. With reflexive access (b1) is idle here (controls, law 5). EndRequires is the teleological means-to-end relation; on the rejected strict-modal reading SS alone with a common root yields NAR (controls, law 6) and N3 would beg the question. Shared dependencies: 0c27f65a and 5c1aba17 (hence will following intellect, 090be689) are also inputs of #1944's arguments 2 and 5, so N3 adds nothing against a rival that denies intellect at the root; its value is against an Avicennian-style rival that grants the common root's direct reach, intellect, willed giving, one power, (b1) and SS on the means-to-end reading: that rival must deny WN. Which premise the historical Avicennian system denies is unresolved (unread): if its emanation is mediated (from the one only one proceeds), it denies 0c27f65a's direct reach and is the mediated-creator variant, against which N3 does nothing. Omission models: without WN and without SS (the mixed-mode root), without 5c1aba17 (natural emanation by an intellectual root), without one power, without 0c27f65a (an emanating root without intellect), without (b1) (a non-reflexive frame).
